lines: ① Try boots on in the afternoon.
③ Roll your sole on a ball, 1–2 min.
④ Calf stretch, 30 sec each side.

caption:
Lulu walks the site in steel-cap boots for ten hours a day, and by knock-off her feet are throbbing.

Safety boots are a must, but if the length or width isn't right, your feet can struggle over a long shift. A good fit and cushioned socks can help.

Hybi's tip: try boots on in the afternoon when feet are a little bigger, wear cushioned work socks, and roll your sole on a ball and stretch your calves after work.

Swelling, warmth, tingling or numbness is worth an assessment first. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio
